summary: American Airlines filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a $235.765 million pass-through trust offering of Class B Certificates, Series 2026-1B, to finance 32 aircraft including Boeing 737 MAX 8, Airbus A321 XLR, and older models. The certificates are asset-backed by equipment notes secured by the aircraft, with semiannual interest at 5.75% due from November 10, 2026, and final distribution in 2035. The Class B certificates are subordinate to Class A. Natixis provides a liquidity facility for three interest periods. This is a routine debt/asset-backed securities issuance, not a special situation.
